helpCenter.AuxiliaryToolsDes: Auxiliary tools will help our technical support team diagnose problems faster and are recommended by technical support engineers.
helpCenter.access_open_tips: For system security, it is recommended to set shorter duration or manually disable SSH after Technical Support service ended
helpCenter.debugModelTips: In debug mode, the system will consume more resource performance. It is recommended to set an appropriate validity period under the guidance of technical support engineers. After the validity period expires, the system will automatically disable the debugging mode.

helpCenter.openAcessOpenControlTip: To enable remote access service, please go to the [Control Panel] to enable UGREENlink first.

helpCenter.remoteAccessDes: To ensure device security, you will need to set the validity period for remote access. After the validity period expires, the system will automatically turn off remote access.
helpCenter.open_ssh_tips: Enabling this feature automatically activates SSH (Control Panel > Terminal > SSH) and opens the port for remote assistance by support engineers. Please operate under engineer guidance
